```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = 'center'
)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(ggsci)
library(showtext)
library(here)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r parameters}
# ========== CONFIGURATION ==========
# These should match kaist/config.R settings
project_name <- "kmip2023"
output_prefix <- "kaist_report"

# Output directory (relative to project root)
output_dir <- file.path(here(), "projects", project_name, "output")

# ========== SCENARIO SELECTION ==========
# Manual reporting scenario
manual_scenario <- "NZAdv"

# Automated reporting scenario
auto_scenario <- "NZAdv"
auto_region <- "South Korea"
```

```{r load-data}
# Load manual data (first sheet)
manual_data <- read_excel(
  file.path(output_dir, "template.xlsx"),
  sheet = 1
) %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  filter(
    scenario == manual_scenario,
  ) %>%
  # Select only 5-year interval columns to match auto data
  select(scenario, variable, unit,
         `2020`, `2025`, `2030`, `2035`, `2040`, `2045`, `2050`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`2020`, `2025`, `2030`, `2035`, `2040`, `2045`, `2050`),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    source = "Manual"
  ) %>%
  select(scenario, variable, unit, year, value, source)

# Load automated data
auto_data <- read_csv(
  file.path(output_dir, "variables_after_unit_conversion.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  filter(
    scenario == auto_scenario,
    region == auto_region
  ) %>%
  select(scenario, variable, unit,
         `2020`, `2025`, `2030`, `2035`, `2040`, `2045`, `2050`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`2020`, `2025`, `2030`, `2035`, `2040`, `2045`, `2050`),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    source = "Auto"
  ) %>%
  select(scenario, variable, unit, year, value, source)

# Combine data - filter for common years (2020-2050)
combined_data <- bind_rows(manual_data, auto_data) %>%
  filter(year >= 2020, year <= 2050) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))
```

```{r plotting-functions}

# Function to create comparison page with multi-panel stacked bar chart
create_comparison_page <- function(data,
                                   positive_vars,
                                   negative_vars = NULL,
                                   manual_scenario,
                                   auto_scenario) {

  # Combine all variables
  all_vars <- c(positive_vars, negative_vars)

  # Filter and prepare data
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(variable %in% all_vars)

  # Handle case when no data exists for requested variables
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    empty_plot <- ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
               label = "No data available for these variables",
               size = 8, color = "gray50") +
      theme_void()

    return(list(
      plot = empty_plot,
      table = tibble(Year = character(), Manual = numeric(), Auto = numeric()),
      detail_2030 = NULL,
      detail_2050 = NULL,
      unit = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      # Classify as positive or negative
      var_type = case_when(
        variable %in% negative_vars ~ "negative",
        variable %in% positive_vars ~ "positive",
        TRUE ~ "positive"
      ),
      # Apply sign based on type
      value = ifelse(var_type == "negative", -abs(value), abs(value)),
      # Keep full variable name for legend
      variable_full = variable,
      # Create factor for consistent ordering
      variable_ordered = factor(variable, levels = all_vars)
    )

  # Get unit (assuming same unit for all variables)
  unit_val <- plot_data %>%
    pull(unit) %>%
    unique() %>%
    first()

  # Calculate y-axis limits
  y_limits <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(source, year) %>%
    summarise(
      pos_total = sum(value[var_type == "positive"], na.rm = TRUE),
      neg_total = sum(value[var_type == "negative"], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      y_min = min(neg_total, 0) * 1.1,
      y_max = max(pos_total) * 1.05
    )

  # Define consistent color palette
  n_vars <- length(all_vars)
  color_palette <- pal_d3("category20")(min(n_vars, 20))
  if (n_vars > 20) {
    color_palette <- colorRampPalette(pal_d3("category20")(20))(n_vars)
  }
  names(color_palette) <- all_vars

  # Create multi-panel stacked bar chart
  combined_plot <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("Manual", "Auto"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, fill = variable_ordered)) +
    geom_col(width = 4, color = NA, position = "stack") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ source, ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(source = c(
      "Manual" = paste0("Manual (", manual_scenario, ")"),
      "Auto" = paste0("Auto (", auto_scenario, ")")
    ))) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_palette,
      labels = all_vars,
      breaks = all_vars,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = comma,
      limits = c(y_limits$y_min, y_limits$y_max)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2020, 2050, 5)) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = ifelse(is.na(unit_val), "", unit_val)
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 24),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(1.6, "cm"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey50"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines")
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = FALSE, reverse = FALSE))

  # Create summary table
  summary_stats <- plot_data %>%
    filter(year %in% c(2020, 2030, 2040, 2050)) %>%
    group_by(source, year) %>%
    summarise(
      total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = source,
      values_from = total
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = as.character(year)
    )

  # Add comparison columns if both Manual and Auto exist
  if ("Manual" %in% names(summary_stats) && "Auto" %in% names(summary_stats)) {
    summary_stats <- summary_stats %>%
      mutate(
        Difference = Auto - Manual,
        `Diff (%)` = round((Difference / Manual) * 100, 1)
      ) %>%
      select(year, Manual, Auto, Difference, `Diff (%)`)
  }

  # Create detailed variable-level comparison tables
  create_detail_table <- function(data, target_year, all_vars) {
    wide_data <- data %>%
      filter(year == target_year) %>%
      select(variable, source, value) %>%
      group_by(variable, source) %>%
      summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = value)

    if (!("Manual" %in% names(wide_data)) || !("Auto" %in% names(wide_data))) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    wide_data <- wide_data %>%
      mutate(
        Manual = as.numeric(Manual),
        Auto = as.numeric(Auto)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Manual) & !is.na(Auto) & Manual != 0)

    if (nrow(wide_data) == 0) return(NULL)

    wide_data %>%
      mutate(
        Difference = Auto - Manual,
        diff_pct = (Difference / Manual) * 100,
        variable_original = variable,
        variable = gsub("\\|", "/", variable)
      ) %>%
      filter(abs(diff_pct) >= 1) %>%
      mutate(
        `Diff (%)` = diff_pct,
        variable_order = factor(variable_original, levels = all_vars)
      ) %>%
      select(-diff_pct, -variable_original) %>%
      arrange(variable_order) %>%
      select(-variable_order)
  }

  detail_2030 <- create_detail_table(plot_data, 2030, all_vars)
  detail_2050 <- create_detail_table(plot_data, 2050, all_vars)

  list(
    plot = combined_plot,
    table = summary_stats,
    detail_2030 = detail_2030,
    detail_2050 = detail_2050,
    unit = unit_val
  )
}
```

\newpage

## 1. Emissions|CO2

```{r page1-co2, fig.width=20, fig.height=10}
co2_positive_vars <- c(
  "Emissions|CO2|Energy|Demand|Building",
  "Emissions|CO2|Energy|Demand|Industry",
  "Emissions|CO2|Energy|Demand|Transportation",
  "Emissions|CO2|Energy|Supply|Electricity",
  "Emissions|CO2|Energy|Supply|Heat",
  "Emissions|CO2|Energy|Supply|Hydrogen",
  "Emissions|CO2|Energy|Supply|Other Energy",
  "Emissions|CO2|Energy|Supply|Refinery",
  "Emissions|GHGs|Non-Energy|Industrial Process"
)

co2_negative_vars <- c(
  "Carbon Sequestration|DAC"
)

result <- create_comparison_page(
  data = combined_data,
  positive_vars = co2_positive_vars,
  negative_vars = co2_negative_vars,
  manual_scenario = manual_scenario,
  auto_scenario = auto_scenario
)

print(result$plot)
```

```{r page1-table, results='asis'}
knitr::kable(
  result$table,
  caption = paste0("Total Net Emissions by Year (", result$unit, ")"),
  digits = 1,
  format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
  escape = FALSE
) %>%
kableExtra::kable_styling(font_size = 9)

if (!is.null(result$detail_2030) && nrow(result$detail_2030) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(
    result$detail_2030,
    caption = paste0("2030 Variable-level Comparison (", result$unit, ")"),
    digits = c(0, 2, 2, 2, 1),
    format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
    col.names = c("Variable", "Manual", "Auto", "Diff", "Diff (%)"),
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), font_size = 9) %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "7cm")
}

if (!is.null(result$detail_2050) && nrow(result$detail_2050) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(
    result$detail_2050,
    caption = paste0("2050 Variable-level Comparison (", result$unit, ")"),
    digits = c(0, 2, 2, 2, 1),
    format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
    col.names = c("Variable", "Manual", "Auto", "Diff", "Diff (%)"),
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), font_size = 9) %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "7cm")
}
```
